# 🔄 ALTERNATIVE CONVERSION METHODS

If you need to reconvert in future:

### Method 1: Batch Script (Easiest)
```cmd
ConvertToWord.bat
```

### Method 2: PowerShell
```powershell
.\Convert-MarkdownToWord.ps1
```

### Method 3: Pandoc Command
```bash
pandoc manual.md -o manual.docx --toc
```

### Method 4: Word Direct Import
1. File → Open
2. Select .md file
3. File → Save As → DOCX

# 📞 TECHNICAL DETAILS

## Conversion Process Flow

```
Source Markdown File
    ↓
PowerShell Script reads file
    ↓

    ↓
Uses Word COM Object (if no Pandoc)
    ↓
Parses markdown structure
    ↓
Formats headings, code, text
    ↓
Generates DOCX file
    ↓
Saves to disk
    ↓
Success message
    ↓
Word Document Ready!
```
